surprises: The phase's 'out of scope' forbade touching list-influencers schemas, yet its Notes required importing the allowed age-group set, forcing an AgeGroupSchema export from that file as the minimal non-behavioral reconciliation.
The smoke case asserts rows.length > 0 for all four vocabularies, coupling to warehouse population against the learned smoke-shape rule.
The category query aliases with rawAs(...,"value") while country/gender/age use inline "col AS value" strings, mixing two aliasing idioms in one module.

proposed_rules.diff: + Within one query module, pick a single column-aliasing idiom. Alias a plain column with an inline `"col AS value"` projection; reserve `rawAs(expr, "value")` for a scalar expression that needs it (aggregate, cast, arithmetic). Do not mix the two for equivalent plain-column aliases in the same file.

followups: P2: Drop the population-coupled `rows.length > 0` assertions from influencer-filter-options.smoke.ts and keep only assertOptionShape; the ageGroupVocabulary variant is especially population-coupled since it filters to allowed buckets.

P3: Centralize the duplicated `FilterOption` interface and the toSorted count-desc-then-localeCompare collation shared across the influencer, athlete, and artist filter-options mappers once a fourth consumer appears.
